nodes.label: Dependabot Config
nodes.rationale: Weekly updates for gomod, npm (/ui), github-actions, and docker (/backend, /ui); minor/patch grouped to reduce PR noise.

nodes.label: CodeQL Workflow
nodes.rationale: Not path-filtered because security scanning should not depend on which side of the monorepo changed; matrix over go and javascript-typescript.

nodes.label: Dependabot Auto-Merge Workflow
nodes.rationale: Uses pull_request_target because Dependabot pull_request events get a read-only token; never checks out PR code so nothing to hijack. Enables native auto-merge so merge waits for all required checks.

nodes.label: Docker Workflow (build-only image validation)
nodes.rationale: Build-only, no push or secrets; would have caught backend Dockerfile pinning older Go than go.mod. Separate backend/ui filter keys so one side's PR doesn't wait on the other's image.

nodes.label: Go Workflow (build, test, lint, govulncheck)
nodes.rationale: Tests on Go 1.27 and stable with -race -shuffle; golangci-lint only-new-issues on PRs and non-blocking on push to main until baseline cleaned up.

nodes.label: Node.js CI Workflow (SvelteKit UI)
nodes.rationale: pnpm frozen install, type-check, lint, build, vitest incl. browser-mode tests requiring Playwright Chromium.

nodes.label: golangci-lint Config (v2)
nodes.rationale: Linters grouped by correctness, style, and security; gosec/bodyclose/noctx complement govulncheck's dependency CVE scan with SAST on own code.

nodes.label: DEPENDABOT_COMPAT_PAT secret
nodes.rationale: fetch-metadata rejects the default GITHUB_TOKEN for compat-lookup.

nodes.label: Trivy Image Scan (report-only SARIF)
nodes.rationale: exit-code 0 until the base-image CVE baseline is reviewed; flip to 1 to block.

nodes.label: Bot PR Approval (github-actions[bot])
nodes.rationale: Satisfies required-approval branch protection; works because approver and author identities differ. CODEOWNERS requirements still block for a human, as intended fallback.

nodes.label: Compatibility Score Gate (>80% or no score)
nodes.norm_label: compatibility score gate (>80% or no score)
nodes.rationale: Score 0 treated as 'no score' and non-blocking since compatibility scores are effectively npm/pip-only; requiring one would block Go, Docker and Actions updates forever.

nodes.label: Paths-Filter Changes Gate Pattern
nodes.rationale: Jobs gated via a dorny/paths-filter 'changes' job instead of workflow-level on.paths so the workflow always posts a status; if-skipped jobs count as passing required checks while never-triggered workflows stay pending forever.

nodes.label: Aerendil Wordmark
nodes.rationale: Outlined-path text 'Aerendil' placed right of the emblem in the 315x64 full logo.

nodes.label: Pill Emblem with Dot and Four-Point Star
nodes.norm_label: pill emblem with dot and four-point star
nodes.rationale: Rounded pill (toggle-like) containing a dim dot on the left and a bright blue (#4C8DFF) four-pointed star on the right; the star evokes the Earendil evening star the product is named after.

nodes.label: Blue Four-Point Star Motif
nodes.rationale: Single shared star path (#4C8DFF) reused across favicon, marks and logos as the core brand glyph.

nodes.label: Light/Dark Theme Logo Variants
nodes.rationale: Light variants use a filled navy (#0E1A2B) pill; dark variants swap to an outlined off-white (#F3F1EC) stroke pill with a lighter dot so the emblem reads on dark backgrounds.

nodes.label: CI workflows (go.yml, node.js.yml, codeql.yml, docker.yml)
nodes.rationale: Path-filtered per side; only run the suite for the side touched. CodeQL and Docker/Trivy scan whole repo.

nodes.label: Pre-paint theme init script (aerendil-theme localStorage key)
nodes.norm_label: pre-paint theme init script (aerendil-theme localstorage key)
nodes.rationale: Runs before paint to toggle the dark class from stored preference or prefers-color-scheme, avoiding theme flash.

nodes.label: Seeded immutable Admin group + bootstrap admin user
nodes.norm_label: seeded immutable admin group + bootstrap admin user

nodes.label: FQDP server stub (backend/internal/fqdp)
nodes.rationale: Only framing and Handshake parsing exist; always replies ErrHandshakeNotImplemented. docs/fqdp.md is target spec, not current behavior.

nodes.label: HTTP API (backend/internal/api, stdlib ServeMux)
nodes.rationale: No framework; Go 1.22+ method patterns on stdlib ServeMux.

nodes.label: Application credentials / OAuth2 client-credentials service tokens
nodes.norm_label: application credentials / oauth2 client-credentials service tokens
nodes.rationale: Service tokens carry typ:service; permissions are exactly the credential's Scopes (flags:read/flags:write), never admin, never via group membership.

nodes.label: SvelteKit admin UI (ui/src)
nodes.rationale: Browsers cannot hold raw TCP sockets, so UI never talks FQDP; backend API is called only from server-side code.

nodes.label: FQDP - Feature Query & Definition Protocol v0.1
nodes.norm_label: fqdp - feature query & definition protocol v0.1
nodes.rationale: Language-agnostic, low-latency queries and push updates for many clients; binary-first with JSON fallback for debugging.

nodes.label: Reconnect and backfill via sequence numbers
nodes.norm_label: reconnect and backfill via sequence numbers

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md
nodes.rationale: Defers to AGENTS.md as single source of truth to avoid Claude-specific duplication.

nodes.label: routes/bff BFF proxy layer
nodes.rationale: Returns backend's real HTTP status instead of SvelteKit form-action embedded status.

nodes.label: Live group-based permission resolution (no caching, nothing in JWT)
nodes.norm_label: live group-based permission resolution (no caching, nothing in jwt)
nodes.rationale: Service.Resolve re-fetches the record each request so group/permission changes and deactivation take effect on the very next request. No RoleAdmin/RoleUser model.

nodes.label: Raft FSM command envelope + snapshotDoc
nodes.rationale: Single command{Op, Entity, ...} envelope dispatched by Entity; one in-memory map per entity guarded by one RWMutex; entity Version is the Raft log index on apply.

nodes.label: Raft-replicated Store (backend/internal/store)
nodes.rationale: No separate embedded DB for app data: Raft log plus FSM snapshot/restore is the durability mechanism. Pre-v1 stance: schema-breaking command/snapshot changes require wiping the Raft data dir rather than migrating.

nodes.label: requirePermission(perm, withAudit(handler)) middleware nesting
nodes.rationale: Order matters: withAudit needs the principal that requirePermission attaches to request context.

nodes.label: 4-byte big-endian length-prefixed framing
nodes.rationale: Protocol provides its own framing; no HTTP upgrade or WebSocket layer.

nodes.label: Durable store + replication, idempotent versioned updates
nodes.norm_label: durable store + replication, idempotent versioned updates

nodes.label: FQDP security considerations (scoped tokens, TLS, rate limits)
nodes.norm_label: fqdp security considerations (scoped tokens, tls, rate limits)

nodes.label: Major.minor version negotiation
nodes.rationale: Major mismatch rejects; minor differences tolerated via feature negotiation bits.

nodes.label: Aerendil core design principles
nodes.rationale: Developers focus on features not flagging; support many languages; handle very large request rates for distributed workloads.

nodes.label: OSI Layer 4 raw TCP instead of HTTP/WebSocket
nodes.norm_label: osi layer 4 raw tcp instead of http/websocket
nodes.rationale: Chosen for efficiency with large numbers of connections in container/Kubernetes distributed workloads.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md (single source of truth for AI agent instructions)
nodes.norm_label: agents.md (single source of truth for ai agent instructions)
nodes.rationale: Consolidated agent instructions kept in one file to avoid Copilot/Claude-specific duplicates.

nodes.label: Stale PRs Workflow
nodes.rationale: Targets PRs that go fully quiet after review; stale at 30 days, close after 7 more; issues untouched; drafts and pinned/do-not-close exempt.
